summary_md: **Jiarong Liang ([@JLiang51825](https://x.com/JLiang51825/status/2115153311292915976))** introduces **ReGE**: an agent synthesizes its own past attempts into guidance for a fresh attempt by the same model. The thread reports GPT-5.6 Luna + ReGE at 67.4% success vs GPT-5.6 Sol at 67.0% for 28% of the cost across Terminal-Bench 2.0, Spider2-Lite, AndroidWorld and BrowseComp-Plus; guidance is one coach call, and gains are largest when attempts disagree. Code is open.

relevance: Experience synthesis as a cheap way to lift a smaller model to a bigger one's level.

media.description: Scatter plot of task success vs cost per task over 4 benchmarks (468 paired tasks): gpt-5.6-luna + ReGE 67.4% at $0.214, gpt-5.6-sol 67.0% at $0.766, gpt-5.6-terra 63.9% at $0.370, gpt-6-luna 49.4% at $0.009.

Method diagram: an LLM's K recorded attempts on a task form a trajectory pool; a coach synthesizes guidance (facts, operations, pitfalls, artifacts) that steers a student in a fresh, reset environment (web, terminal, files, apps), evaluated on Terminal-Bench 2.0, Spider2-Lite, AndroidWorld and BrowseComp-Plus.
